measurement.order: paired versions per case/round; alternating first side each round and fixture; rotating variants
measurement.cache: Node compile cache disabled via NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1; clear Rstest build and sequencing caches once per fixture before warmups; retain across variants and timed rounds
measurement.memory: macOS phys_footprint summed over the command process tree every ~50 ms, excluding the benchmark driver; peak per run
measurement.environment: Inherited environment; BENCH_*, scale and Node compile-cache overrides cleared, then NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 enforced. Only documented non-secret controls saved.
